### FUNCTION atlasParallelMarketMetalsState
function atlasParallelMarketMetalsState() {
  return state.parallelMarkets.metals;
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows
function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 365);
  if (days === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id)
      .map(point => ({ time: point.x, point }));
  }
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows();
  if (!rows.length) return [];
  const newestTime = rows[rows.length - 1].time;
  const cutoff = newestTime - Math.max(1, days) * 86400000;
  const inside = rows.filter(row => row.time >= cutoff);
  const anchor = [...rows].reverse().find(row => row.time < cutoff) || null;
  const selected = anchor ? [anchor, ...inside] : inside;
  const unique = new Map();
  selected.forEach(row => unique.set(String(row.time), row));
  return [...unique.values()].sort((left, right) => left.time - right.time);
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints
function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, periodDays = null) {
  if (Number(periodDays) === 1) {
    return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationIntradayPoints(assetId);
  }
  const rows = periodDays === null
    ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHistoryRows()
    : atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  return rows.map(row => {
    const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(row.snapshot?.quotes)
      .find(item => item?.asset_id === assetId
        && String(item?.instrument_type || "") === "future_continuous");
    const price = Number(quote?.price);
    if (!Number.isFinite(price) || price <= 0) return null;
    return {
      x: row.time,
      y: price,
      currency: String(quote?.currency || "USD").toUpperCase(),
      unit: String(quote?.unit || ""),
      source: "yahoo_finance"
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);
}

### FUNCTION atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries
function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const activeId = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id;
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 365);
  const series = [];

  for (const asset of ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS) {
    if (!selected.has(asset.id)) continue;
    // Les unités et ordres de grandeur diffèrent fortement.
    // En mode Prix, une seule échelle réelle est affichée : l'actif actif.
    // La comparaison multi-actifs est réservée au mode Base 100.
    if (metals.view !== "base100" && asset.id !== activeId) continue;
    const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
    if (!points.length) continue;
    if (metals.view === "base100") {
      const base = points[0].y;
      points.forEach(point => { point.y = (point.y / base) * 100; });
    }
    series.push({
      id: asset.id,
      symbol: asset.symbol,
      color: ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[asset.id],
      points
    });
  }
  return series;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(assetId, periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays);
  const intraday = days === 1;
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(assetId, days);
  const unitLabel = intraday ? "points Futures intraday" : "séances Futures";
  const spanHours = points.length >= 2
    ? Math.max(0, (points[points.length - 1].x - points[0].x) / 3600000)
    : 0;

  if (points.length < 2) {
    const count = points.length;
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      partial: intraday && count > 0,
      state: "insufficient",
      text: intraday ? "Intraday Futures en attente" : "Historique insuffisant",
      detail: intraday
        ? `${count} point${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures intraday réel${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} · première collecte GitHub Actions requise`
        : `${count} séance${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} Futures réelle${count > 1 ? "s" : ""}`,
      points: count,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const first = points[0];
  const last = points[points.length - 1];
  const delta = last.y - first.y;
  const percent = first.y !== 0 ? (delta / first.y) * 100 : null;
  if (!Number.isFinite(percent)) {
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      state: "incoherent",
      text: "Variation non calculable",
      detail: `${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
      points: points.length,
      spanHours
    });
  }

  const sign = percent > 0 ? "+" : "";
  const formatted = new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(percent);
  const dateOptions = intraday
    ? { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }
    : undefined;
  return Object.freeze({
    available: true,
    state: percent > 0 ? "up" : percent < 0 ? "down" : "stable",
    text: `${sign}${formatted} % · ${points.length} ${unitLabel}`,
    detail: `${new Date(first.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)} → ${new Date(last.x).toLocaleString("fr-FR", dateOptions)}`,
    percent,
    delta,
    points: points.length,
    first,
    last,
    spanHours,
    source: intraday ? "yahoo_finance_futures_intraday" : "yahoo_finance_futures_daily"
  });
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(periodDays = null) {
  const days = Number(
    periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7
  );
  const rows = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);
    return Object.freeze({
      asset,
      reading,
      available: reading?.available === true,
      percent: reading?.available === true
        ? Number(reading.percent)
        : null
    });
  });
  const available = rows
    .filter(row => row.available && Number.isFinite(row.percent))
    .sort((left, right) => right.percent - left.percent);
  const leader = available[0] || null;
  const laggard = available[available.length - 1] || null;
  const spread = leader && laggard
    ? leader.percent - laggard.percent
    : null;
  return Object.freeze({
    days,
    rows: Object.freeze(rows),
    available: Object.freeze(available),
    count: available.length,
    complete: available.length === ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length,
    leader,
    laggard,
    spread
  });
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons(assetId = null) {
  const id = String(assetId || atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal()?.id || "gold");
  const historyAvailable = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary().historyAvailable;

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-analysis-horizon]").forEach(card => {
    const days = Number(card.dataset.metalsAnalysisHorizon || 0);
    const output = card.querySelector("small");
    if (!output) return;

    const reading = historyAvailable
      ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(id, days)
      : Object.freeze({
          available: false,
          state: "insufficient",
          text: "Historique public en attente",
          detail: "Aucune valeur de remplacement"
        });

    output.textContent = reading.text;
    output.title = reading.detail || reading.text;
    card.dataset.horizonState = reading.state;
    card.classList.toggle("is-up", reading.state === "up");
    card.classList.toggle("is-down", reading.state === "down");
    card.classList.toggle("is-flat", reading.state === "stable");
    card.classList.toggle(
      "is-insufficient",
      ["insufficient", "intraday_required", "incoherent"].includes(reading.state)
    );
  });

  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriodLabel(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 7);
  if (days === 1) return "24 heures";
  if (days === 365) return "1 an";
  return `${days} jours`;
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(percent) {
  const value = Number(percent);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "unknown", short: "lecture indisponible", sentence: "Variation non calculable" });
  }
  const magnitude = Math.abs(value);
  if (magnitude < 0.25) {
    return Object.freeze({ state: "stable", short: "quasi-stabilité", sentence: "Quasi-stabilité" });
  }
  const up = value > 0;
  if (magnitude < 1) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "légère hausse" : "léger recul",
      sentence: up ? "Légère progression" : "Léger recul"
    });
  }
  if (magnitude < 3) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "hausse modérée" : "baisse modérée",
      sentence: up ? "Progression modérée" : "Baisse modérée"
    });
  }
  if (magnitude < 8) {
    return Object.freeze({
      state: up ? "up" : "down",
      short: up ? "hausse marquée" : "baisse marquée",
      sentence: up ? "Progression marquée" : "Baisse marquée"
    });
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    state: up ? "up" : "down",
    short: up ? "forte hausse" : "fort recul",
    sentence: up ? "Forte progression" : "Fort recul"
  });
}

function atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(percent) {
  const value = Number(percent);
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return "—";
  const sign = value > 0 ? "+" : "";
  return `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(value)} %`;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderHumanReading(assetId = null, periodDays = null) {
  const card = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReading");
  const title = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingTitle");
  const period = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriod");
  const state = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingState");
  const summary = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingSummary");
  const context = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingContext");
  const source = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHumanReadingSource");
  if (!card || !title || !period || !state || !summary || !context || !source) return false;

  const asset = atlasMarketRegistryAssetMeta(
    String(assetId || atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal()?.id || "gold")
  );
  const days = Number(periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7);
  const periodLabel = atlasMetalsHumanReadingPeriodLabel(days);
  const spot = days === 1;
  const allMode = atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive();

  if (allMode) {
    const comparison = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(days);
    title.textContent = `Comparaison des 5 métaux · ${periodLabel}`;
    period.textContent = `XAU · XAG · XPT · XPD · HG · ${periodLabel}`;
    source.textContent = spot
      ? "Comparaison Base 100 · Yahoo Finance Futures intraday · cinq séries séparées · aucune moyenne artificielle."
      : "Comparaison Base 100 · Yahoo Finance Futures · cinq séries séparées · aucune moyenne artificielle.";

    if (!comparison.complete) {
      card.dataset.state = "insufficient";
      state.textContent = `${comparison.count}/5 séries`;
      summary.textContent = "La comparaison globale attend les cinq historiques réels.";
      context.textContent = comparison.rows.map(row => (
        `${row.asset.symbol} : ${row.available ? atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(row.percent) : "non mesuré"}`
      )).join(" · ");
      setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"), "Comparaison historique");
      return false;
    }

    const leaderMove = atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(
      comparison.leader?.percent
    );
    card.dataset.state = leaderMove.state;
    state.textContent = "Comparaison 5/5";
    summary.textContent =
      `Leader ${comparison.leader.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(comparison.leader.percent)}`
      + ` · retard ${comparison.laggard.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(comparison.laggard.percent)}`
      + ` · écart ${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
          maximumFractionDigits: 2
        }).format(comparison.spread)} points.`;
    context.textContent = comparison.rows.map(row => (
      `${row.asset.symbol} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(row.percent)}`
    )).join(" · ");
    setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"), "Comparaison historique");
    return true;
  }

  const activeReading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);

  title.textContent = `${asset.name} · lecture sur ${periodLabel}`;
  period.textContent = `${asset.symbol} · ${periodLabel}`;
  source.textContent = spot
    ? "Historique Yahoo Finance Futures intraday · cotation Gold API distincte · observation uniquement, aucune prévision."
    : "Historique Yahoo Finance Futures · cotation Gold API distincte · observation uniquement, aucune prévision.";

  if (!activeReading) {
    card.dataset.state = "loading";
    state.textContent = "En attente";
    summary.textContent = "Historique public en cours de lecture.";
    context.textContent = "Aucune conclusion de remplacement n’est générée.";
    return false;
  }

  if (!activeReading.available) {
    card.dataset.state = activeReading.state || "insufficient";
    state.textContent = spot ? "En constitution" : "Insuffisant";
    summary.textContent = spot
      ? `La série Futures intraday 24 heures n’est pas encore disponible : ${activeReading.detail}.`
      : "Le nombre de séances disponibles ne permet pas une lecture historique fiable sur cette période.";
  } else {
    const movement = atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(activeReading.percent);
    card.dataset.state = movement.state;
    state.textContent = "Observation";
    summary.textContent = spot
      ? `${movement.sentence} sur 24 heures : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(activeReading.percent)} sur ${activeReading.points} points Futures intraday.`
      : `${movement.sentence} sur ${periodLabel} : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(activeReading.percent)} sur ${activeReading.points} séances Futures.`;
  }

  const horizonLabels = new Map([[7, "7 j"], [30, "30 j"], [90, "90 j"], [365, "1 an"]]);
  const horizonText = [7, 30, 90, 365].map(horizon => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, horizon);
    if (!reading.available) return `${horizonLabels.get(horizon)} : non mesuré`;
    return `${horizonLabels.get(horizon)} : ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingMovement(reading.percent).short}`;
  });
  context.textContent = horizonText.join(" · ");

  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDecision"),
    "Observation historique"
  );
  return Boolean(activeReading.available);
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderResultHeadline(periodDays = null) {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const asset = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const days = Number(periodDays ?? metals.period ?? 7);
  const identity = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsResultIdentity");
  const value = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsResultValue");
  const detail = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsResultDetail");
  const card = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsResultHeadline");
  if (!identity || !value || !detail || !card) return false;

  const label = days === 1 ? "24 HEURES" : days === 365 ? "1 AN" : `${days} JOURS`;

  if (atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive()) {
    const comparison = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(days);
    identity.textContent = `TOUS LES MÉTAUX · 5/5 · ${label}`;
    card.dataset.state = comparison.complete ? "comparison" : "insufficient";
    value.textContent = `${comparison.count}/5 SÉRIES`;
    const values = comparison.rows.map(row => (
      `${row.asset.symbol} ${row.available ? atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(row.percent) : "—"}`
    )).join(" · ");
    const ranking = comparison.leader && comparison.laggard
      ? ` · leader ${comparison.leader.asset.symbol}`
        + ` · retard ${comparison.laggard.asset.symbol}`
        + ` · écart ${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
            maximumFractionDigits: 2
          }).format(comparison.spread)} pt`
      : "";
    detail.textContent = `${values}${ranking}`;
    return comparison.complete;
  }

  identity.textContent = `${String(asset?.name || "Métal").toUpperCase()} · ${asset?.symbol || "—"} · ${label}`;

  const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset?.id || "gold", days);
  card.dataset.state = reading?.state || "loading";

  if (!reading) {
    value.textContent = "HISTORIQUE EN CHARGEMENT";
    detail.textContent = "Lecture des données publiques réelles…";
    return false;
  }
  if (!reading.available) {
    value.textContent = days === 1 ? "EN CONSTITUTION" : "HISTORIQUE INSUFFISANT";
    detail.textContent = reading.detail || reading.text;
    return false;
  }

  const sign = reading.percent > 0 ? "+" : "";
  value.textContent = `${sign}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(reading.percent)} %`;
  const current = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(asset?.id);
  const currentText = current?.price !== null && current?.price !== undefined
    ? ` · cotation actuelle ${atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPriceText(current)} séparée`
    : "";
  const unit = days === 1 ? "points Futures intraday" : "séances Futures";
  detail.textContent = `${reading.points} ${unit} · ${reading.detail}${currentText}`;
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsChartMarketPeriodLabel(periodDays) {
  const days = Number(periodDays || 7);
  if (days === 1) return "24 H";
  if (days === 365) return "1 AN";
  return `${days} J`;
}

const atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState = {
  canvas: null,
  geometry: null,
  baseImage: null,
  pointer: null,
  frame: 0,
  installed: false
};

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPanel() {
  return document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketPanel");
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRestoreBase() {
  const canvas = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas;
  const image = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.baseImage;
  const geometry = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry;
  if (!canvas || !image || !geometry) return false;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return false;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
  ctx.putImageData(image, 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.setTransform(geometry.dpr, 0, 0, geometry.dpr, 0, 0);
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide(options = {}) {
  const panel = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPanel();
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.pointer = null;
  if (options.restore !== false) atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRestoreBase();
  if (!panel) return;
  panel.hidden = true;
  panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
  panel.removeAttribute("data-dock");
  panel.style.removeProperty("left");
  panel.style.removeProperty("top");
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorReset(canvas = null) {
  if (atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame);
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame = 0;
  }
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas = canvas || atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry = null;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.baseImage = null;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide({ restore: false });
}

function atlasMetalsCursorNearestPoint(points, targetX) {
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(points);
  if (!rows.length || !Number.isFinite(Number(targetX))) return null;
  let low = 0;
  let high = rows.length - 1;
  while (low < high) {
    const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    if (Number(rows[middle]?.x) < targetX) low = middle + 1;
    else high = middle;
  }
  const right = rows[low] || null;
  const left = rows[Math.max(0, low - 1)] || null;
  if (!left) return right;
  if (!right) return left;
  return Math.abs(Number(left.x) - targetX) <= Math.abs(Number(right.x) - targetX)
    ? left
    : right;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorMedianInterval(points) {
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationArray(points)
    .map(point => Number(point?.x))
    .filter(Number.isFinite)
    .sort((left, right) => left - right);
  if (rows.length < 2) return Infinity;
  const intervals = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const delta = rows[index] - rows[index - 1];
    if (delta > 0) intervals.push(delta);
  }
  if (!intervals.length) return Infinity;
  intervals.sort((left, right) => left - right);
  return intervals[Math.floor(intervals.length / 2)];
}

function atlasMetalsCursorHistoricalPriceText(value, assetId) {
  const amount = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(amount)) return "—";
  const digits = assetId === "copper"
    ? 4
    : Math.abs(amount) >= 1000 ? 1 : Math.abs(amount) >= 100 ? 2 : 3;
  return `${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    maximumFractionDigits: digits
  }).format(amount)} USD`;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorChangeText(value) {
  const change = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(change)) return "—";
  const normalized = Math.abs(change) < 0.005 ? 0 : change;
  return `${normalized > 0 ? "+" : ""}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(normalized)} %`;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRows(targetX) {
  const geometry = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry;
  if (!geometry) return [];
  const periodDays = Number(geometry.periodDays || 7);
  return geometry.series.map(displaySeries => {
    const rawPoints = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(displaySeries.id, periodDays);
    const rawPoint = atlasMetalsCursorNearestPoint(rawPoints, targetX);
    const displayPoint = atlasMetalsCursorNearestPoint(displaySeries.points, targetX);
    const nativeInterval = atlasMetalsCursorMedianInterval(rawPoints);
    const distance = rawPoint ? Math.abs(Number(rawPoint.x) - Number(targetX)) : Infinity;
    if (!rawPoint || !displayPoint || (Number.isFinite(nativeInterval) && distance > nativeInterval * 4)) return null;
    const first = rawPoints[0] || null;
    const price = Number(rawPoint?.y);
    const change = first && Number(first.y) !== 0 && Number.isFinite(price)
      ? ((price / Number(first.y)) - 1) * 100
      : null;
    const asset = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.find(item => item.id === displaySeries.id) || {
      id: displaySeries.id,
      symbol: displaySeries.symbol || displaySeries.id.toUpperCase(),
      name: displaySeries.symbol || displaySeries.id
    };
    return {
      asset,
      color: displaySeries.color || ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[displaySeries.id] || "#9fb3c2",
      rawPoint,
      displayPoint,
      price,
      change,
      time: Number(rawPoint?.x ?? displayPoint?.x)
    };
  }).filter(row => row && row.rawPoint && row.displayPoint && Number.isFinite(row.time));
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorTimestamp(rows, targetX) {
  const activeId = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal()?.id;
  const preferred = rows.find(row => row.asset.id === activeId) || rows[0] || null;
  return Number(preferred?.time || targetX);
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPosition(canvas, pointerX, pointerY) {
  const panel = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPanel();
  const stage = canvas?.parentElement;
  if (!panel || !stage) return;
  const width = panel.offsetWidth || 350;
  const height = panel.offsetHeight || 260;
  const stageWidth = stage.clientWidth || canvas.clientWidth || 760;
  const stageHeight = stage.clientHeight || canvas.clientHeight || 230;
  const gap = 18;
  const edge = 10;
  const roomRight = stageWidth - pointerX - gap - edge;
  const roomLeft = pointerX - gap - edge;
  const previous = panel.dataset.dock === "left" || panel.dataset.dock === "right"
    ? panel.dataset.dock
    : "";
  const tolerance = 34;
  let dock = previous || (roomRight >= width || roomRight >= roomLeft ? "right" : "left");
  if (dock === "right" && roomRight < width && roomLeft > roomRight + tolerance) dock = "left";
  if (dock === "left" && roomLeft < width && roomRight > roomLeft + tolerance) dock = "right";
  let left = dock === "left" ? pointerX - width - gap : pointerX + gap;
  let top = pointerY - height * .5;
  left = clamp(edge, Math.max(edge, stageWidth - width - edge), left);
  top = clamp(edge, Math.max(edge, stageHeight - height - edge), top);
  panel.dataset.dock = dock;
  panel.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
  panel.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRenderPanel(rows, targetX, pointerX, pointerY) {
  const panel = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPanel();
  const geometry = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry;
  if (!panel || !geometry || !rows.length) {
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide();
    return false;
  }
  const stamp = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorTimestamp(rows, targetX);
  const intraday = Number(geometry.periodDays) === 1;
  const time = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketTime");
  const origin = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketOrigin");
  const period = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketPeriod");
  const source = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMarketSource");
  if (time) {
    const date = new Date(stamp);
    time.textContent = date.toLocaleString("fr-FR", intraday
      ? { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" }
      : { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" });
    time.dateTime = date.toISOString();
  }
  if (origin) origin.textContent = intraday
    ? "Yahoo Finance Futures · point intraday 5 min"
    : "Yahoo Finance Futures · séance quotidienne";
  if (period) period.textContent = `PÉRIODE ACTIVE · ${atlasMetalsChartMarketPeriodLabel(geometry.periodDays)}`;
  if (source) source.textContent = `${rows.length}/${geometry.series.length} série${geometry.series.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} · variation depuis le début de la fenêtre`;

  const byId = new Map(rows.map(row => [row.asset.id, row]));
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-chart-market-row]").forEach(node => {
    const row = byId.get(String(node.dataset.metalsChartMarketRow || ""));
    node.hidden = !row;
    if (!row) return;
    const price = node.querySelector("[data-metals-chart-market-price]");
    const change = node.querySelector("[data-metals-chart-market-change]");
    const stateName = row.change > 0 ? "up" : row.change < 0 ? "down" : "flat";
    node.dataset.state = stateName;
    if (price) price.textContent = atlasMetalsCursorHistoricalPriceText(row.price, row.asset.id);
    if (change) change.textContent = atlasMetalsCursorChangeText(row.change);
    node.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      `${row.asset.name}, prix historique ${atlasMetalsCursorHistoricalPriceText(row.price, row.asset.id)}, variation ${atlasMetalsCursorChangeText(row.change)}`
    );
  });

  panel.hidden = false;
  panel.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "false");
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPosition(geometry.canvas, pointerX, pointerY);
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorDraw(rows, targetX, pointerX, pointerY) {
  const geometry = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry;
  if (!geometry || !atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRestoreBase()) return false;
  const ctx = geometry.canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return false;
  const guideX = geometry.sx(targetX);
  ctx.save();
  ctx.setLineDash([4, 5]);
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(219,239,249,.42)";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(guideX, geometry.pad.top);
  ctx.lineTo(guideX, geometry.height - geometry.pad.bottom);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  rows.forEach(row => {
    const point = row.displayPoint;
    if (!point) return;
    const x = geometry.sx(Number(point.x));
    const y = geometry.sy(Number(point.y));
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 5.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(3,10,20,.96)";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = row.color;
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(x, y, 2.15, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = row.color;
    ctx.fill();
  });
  ctx.restore();
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRenderPanel(rows, targetX, pointerX, pointerY);
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorUpdate() {
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame = 0;
  const geometry = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry;
  const pointer = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.pointer;
  if (!geometry || !pointer) return;
  const { x, y } = pointer;
  const inside = x >= geometry.pad.left
    && x <= geometry.width - geometry.pad.right
    && y >= geometry.pad.top
    && y <= geometry.height - geometry.pad.bottom;
  if (!inside) {
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide();
    return;
  }
  const ratio = clamp(0, 1, (x - geometry.pad.left) / geometry.plotW);
  const targetX = geometry.minX + ratio * (geometry.maxX - geometry.minX);
  const rows = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorRows(targetX);
  if (!rows.length) {
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide();
    return;
  }
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorDraw(rows, targetX, x, y);
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPointerMove(event) {
  const canvas = atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas;
  if (!canvas || canvas.hidden || atlasParallelMarketDomain() !== "metals") return;
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.pointer = {
    x: event.clientX - rect.left,
    y: event.clientY - rect.top
  };
  if (!atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame) {
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.frame = requestAnimationFrame(atlasMetalsCursorInspectorUpdate);
  }
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorCommitBase(canvas, geometry) {
  const ctx = canvas?.getContext("2d");
  if (!canvas || !ctx || !geometry) return false;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas = canvas;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.geometry = { ...geometry, canvas };
  try {
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.baseImage = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  } catch {
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.baseImage = null;
  }
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide({ restore: false });
  return !!atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.baseImage;
}

function atlasMetalsCursorInspectorInit() {
  if (atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.installed) return true;
  const canvas = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartCanvas");
  if (!canvas) return false;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.installed = true;
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorState.canvas = canvas;
  canvas.addEventListener("pointermove", atlasMetalsCursorInspectorPointerMove, { passive: true });
  canvas.addEventListener("pointerleave", () => atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide());
  canvas.addEventListener("pointercancel", () => atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide());
  window.addEventListener("blur", () => atlasMetalsCursorInspectorHide());
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartCanvas");
  const message = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMessage");
  const messageTitle = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMessageTitle");
  const messageText = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMessageText");
  const source = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartSource");
  if (!canvas) return false;

  const series = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries();
  document.querySelectorAll(".atlas-metals-axis-y, .atlas-metals-axis-x")
    .forEach(axis => { axis.hidden = series.length > 0; });
  const pointCount = Math.max(0, ...series.map(item => item.points.length));
  const periodDays = Number(atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period || 7);
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderResultHeadline(periodDays);
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderHumanReading(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id, periodDays);
  const periodLabel = atlasChartPeriodLabel(periodDays);
  const comparisonPrefix = atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive()
    ? "Comparaison Base 100 · 5/5 · "
    : "";
  const originLabel = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin === "local_bridge"
    ? `${comparisonPrefix}Bridge local · cache complémentaire · ${periodLabel}`
    : atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin === "book_memory"
      ? `${comparisonPrefix}Mémoire publique · IndexedDB · ${periodLabel}`
      : atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin === "github_archive"
        ? periodDays === 1
          ? `${comparisonPrefix}Yahoo Finance Futures · intraday 5 min · fenêtre 24 h`
          : `${comparisonPrefix}Yahoo Finance Futures · quotidien · ${periodLabel}`
        : "Source réelle requise";
  if (source) source.textContent = originLabel;

  const rect = canvas.parentElement?.getBoundingClientRect();
  const width = Math.max(320, Math.round(rect?.width || 760));
  const height = Math.max(150, Math.round(rect?.height || 230));
  const dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1));
  canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
  canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
  canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  if (!ctx) return false;
  ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

  if (!series.length) {
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorReset(canvas);
    canvas.hidden = true;
    if (message) message.hidden = false;
    const quoteSummary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();
    const intradayPending = periodDays === 1;
    if (messageTitle) messageTitle.textContent = intradayPending
      ? "INTRADAY FUTURES EN ATTENTE"
      : quoteSummary.quoteCount > 0
        ? `COTATIONS ${quoteSummary.quoteCount}/5 CONNECTÉES`
        : "AUCUNE COTATION CONNECTÉE";
    if (messageText) messageText.textContent = intradayPending
      ? "La prochaine exécution GitHub Actions doit publier la série Yahoo Futures intraday complète ; aucune attente d’accumulation sur 24 heures."
      : quoteSummary.quoteCount > 0
        ? "Les prix actuels sont disponibles. L’historique annuel reste en attente ; aucune courbe n’est inventée."
        : "Le cadre est prêt. Aucune courbe ni valeur n’est inventée.";
    return false;
  }

  canvas.hidden = false;
  if (message) message.hidden = pointCount > 1;
  if (messageTitle) messageTitle.textContent = pointCount === 1
    ? (periodDays === 1 ? "PREMIER POINT FUTURES INTRADAY" : "PREMIER SNAPSHOT RÉEL ENREGISTRÉ")
    : "HISTORIQUE RÉEL";
  if (messageText) messageText.textContent = pointCount === 1
    ? "Un second point Futures intraday est nécessaire pour former une trajectoire."
    : periodDays === 1
      ? `${pointCount} points Yahoo Finance Futures intraday dans la fenêtre 24 heures.`
      : `${pointCount} séances publiques réelles sur la période sélectionnée.`;

  const pad = { left: 48, right: 18, top: 18, bottom: 34 };
  const plotW = Math.max(1, width - pad.left - pad.right);
  const plotH = Math.max(1, height - pad.top - pad.bottom);
  const all = series.flatMap(item => item.points);
  let minX = Math.min(...all.map(point => point.x));
  let maxX = Math.max(...all.map(point => point.x));
  let minY = Math.min(...all.map(point => point.y));
  let maxY = Math.max(...all.map(point => point.y));
  if (minX === maxX) { minX -= 1800000; maxX += 1800000; }
  if (minY === maxY) {
    const margin = Math.max(0.01, Math.abs(minY) * 0.01);
    minY -= margin; maxY += margin;
  } else {
    const margin = (maxY - minY) * 0.08;
    minY -= margin; maxY += margin;
  }
  const sx = value => pad.left + ((value - minX) / (maxX - minX)) * plotW;
  const sy = value => pad.top + (1 - ((value - minY) / (maxY - minY))) * plotH;

  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(174,190,202,.16)";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(174,190,202,.7)";
  ctx.font = "10px system-ui";
  for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i += 1) {
    const y = pad.top + (plotH * i / 4);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pad.left, y); ctx.lineTo(width - pad.right, y); ctx.stroke();
    const value = maxY - ((maxY - minY) * i / 4);
    ctx.fillText(new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", { maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value), 4, y + 3);
  }

  const allSeriesMode = atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive();
  for (const item of series) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = item.color;
    ctx.fillStyle = item.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = allSeriesMode
      ? 2
      : item.id === atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id ? 2.4 : 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    item.points.forEach((point, index) => {
      const x = sx(point.x); const y = sy(point.y);
      if (index === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    });
    if (item.points.length > 1) ctx.stroke();
    const visiblePoints = allSeriesMode
      ? item.points.slice(-1)
      : item.points;
    visiblePoints.forEach(point => {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(sx(point.x), sy(point.y), allSeriesMode ? 3 : 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    });
  }

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(174,190,202,.72)";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText(new Date(minX).toLocaleDateString("fr-FR", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "2-digit" }), pad.left, height - 10);
  ctx.textAlign = "right";
  ctx.fillText(new Date(maxX).toLocaleDateString("fr-FR", { day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "2-digit" }), width - pad.right, height - 10);
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  atlasMetalsCursorInspectorCommitBase(canvas, {
    periodDays,
    series,
    pad,
    plotW,
    plotH,
    minX,
    maxX,
    minY,
    maxY,
    sx,
    sy,
    width,
    height,
    dpr
  });
  return true;
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderMarketRows() {
  document
    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-row]")
    .forEach(row => {
      const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(
        row.dataset.metalsMarketRow
      );
      if (!quote || quote.price === null) return;
      const cells = row.querySelectorAll("td");
      if (cells.length < 8) return;
      cells[4].textContent = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPriceText(quote);
      cells[5].textContent = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChangeText(quote);
      cells[6].textContent = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSourceLabel(quote);
      cells[7].textContent = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationStateLabel(quote);
      row.dataset.metalsQuoteState = quote.data_state;
    });

  document
    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-card]")
    .forEach(card => {
      const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(
        card.dataset.metalsMarketCard
      );
      const value = card.querySelector("em");
      if (value) {
        value.textContent = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPriceText(quote);
      }
    });
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderActive(assetId = null) {
  const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(assetId);
  const summary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();

  if (!quote || quote.price === null) {
    setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailPrice"), "—");
    setText(
      document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDataState"),
      "Structure disponible · cotation absente"
    );
    setText(
      document.getElementById("atlasMetalsAnalysisQuoteState"),
      "Non connectée"
    );
    setText(
      document.getElementById("atlasMetalsAnalysisQuoteDetail"),
      summary.domain
    );
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons(assetId);
    return false;
  }

  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailPrice"),
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPriceText(quote)
  );
  const eurText = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationEurText(quote);
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailUnit"),
    `${quote.unit_label_fr || `${String(quote.currency || "").toUpperCase()} / ${String(quote.unit || "unité source")}`}${eurText ? ` · ${eurText} indicatif BCE` : ""}`
  );
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailDataState"),
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationStateLabel(quote)
  );
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsAnalysisQuoteState"),
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPriceText(quote)
  );
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsAnalysisQuoteDetail"),
    `${atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSourceLabel(quote)} · source ${quote.source_time || "date absente"}${eurText ? ` · ${eurText} indicatif BCE` : ""}`
  );

  const historyAvailable = summary.historyAvailable;
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsAnalysisState"),
    historyAvailable ? "Historique réel" : "Cotation actuelle"
  );
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsAnalysisIntro"),
    historyAvailable
      ? "Cotation actuelle Gold API séparée de l’historique Futures quotidien public ; aucun mélange spot/Futures."
      : "Cotation actuelle Gold API disponible ; historique Futures public en attente."
  );
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsAnalysisProvenance"),
    historyAvailable
      ? "Gold API · Yahoo Finance Futures · BCE · USGS MCS 2026 · décision humaine."
      : "Gold API · BCE · USGS MCS 2026 · historique Futures en attente."
  );
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsIntegrityText"),
    historyAvailable
      ? "Cotation actuelle et série Futures séparées · unités conservées · aucun prix ni point inventé."
      : "Cotation actuelle qualifiée · historique absent · aucune valeur de remplacement inventée."
  );
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons(quote.asset_id);
  return true;
}

async function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationLoadCore() {
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status = "loading";
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = null;

  let archiveError = null;
  try {
    const archive = await atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationLoadFromArchive();
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.snapshot = archive.snapshot;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.collector = archive.collector;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.historyIndex = archive.historyIndex;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.history = archive.history.snapshots;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory = archive.intradayHistory;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.spotHistory = archive.spotHistory.snapshots;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.contract = archive.contract;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.quotes = archive.snapshot.quotes;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status = archive.snapshot.quotes.length
      ? "loaded"
      : "ready_empty";
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin = "github_archive";
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.loadedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = null;
  } catch (error) {
    archiveError = String(error?.message || error || "Archive publique Métaux indisponible");
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status = "unavailable";
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin = "none";
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.snapshot = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.collector = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.historyIndex = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.history = Object.freeze([]);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.spotHistory = Object.freeze([]);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.contract = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.quotes = Object.freeze([]);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.loadedAt = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = archiveError;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.status;
}

async function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationReloadHistoryCore() {
  try {
    let history = null;
    let intradayHistory = null;
    let spotHistory = null;
    if (["github_archive", "book_memory", "interface_memory"].includes(
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin
    )) {
      [history, intradayHistory, spotHistory] = await Promise.all([
        atlasMarketRegistryFetchJson(ATLAS_METALS_QUOTE_FOUNDATION_PATHS.historyResponse)
          .then(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateHistoryResponse),
        atlasMarketRegistryFetchJson(ATLAS_METALS_QUOTE_FOUNDATION_PATHS.intradayHistory)
          .then(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateIntradayHistory)
          .catch(() => null),
        atlasMarketRegistryFetchJson(ATLAS_METALS_QUOTE_FOUNDATION_PATHS.spotHistory)
          .then(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateSpotHistory)
          .catch(() => null)
      ]);
    } else if (atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.origin === "local_bridge") {
      const period = Number(atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period || 1);
      const route = await atlasMetalsBridgeFetchJson(
        `${ATLAS_METALS_BRIDGE_PATHS.history}?days=${period}`
      );
      history = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationValidateHistoryResponse(route?.history);
    }
    if (!history && !intradayHistory && !spotHistory) {
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart();
      return false;
    }
    if (history) atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.history = history.snapshots;
    if (intradayHistory) atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.intradayHistory = intradayHistory;
    if (spotHistory) atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.spotHistory = spotHistory.snapshots;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = null;
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons();
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart();
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.error = String(error?.message || error);
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderAnalysisHorizons();
    atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart();
    return false;
  }
}

function atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsMarket() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const active = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const filter = [
    "all",
    "monetary",
    "precious-industrial",
    "industrial"
  ].includes(String(metals.marketFilter || ""))
    ? String(metals.marketFilter)
    : "all";

  document
    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-card]")
    .forEach(button => {
      const id = button.dataset.metalsMarketCard;
      button.hidden = !selected.has(id);
      button.classList.toggle("is-focus", id === active.id);
      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-current",
        id === active.id ? "true" : "false"
      );
    });

  document
    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-row]")
    .forEach(row => {
      const id = row.dataset.metalsMarketRow;
      const family = row.dataset.metalsMarketFamily;
      const matches =
        selected.has(id)
        && (filter === "all" || family === filter);

      row.hidden = !matches;
      row.classList.toggle("is-focus", id === active.id);
    });

  document
    .querySelectorAll("[data-metals-market-filter]")
    .forEach(button => {
      const isActive =
        button.dataset.metalsMarketFilter === filter;
      button.classList.toggle("is-active", isActive);
      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-pressed",
        isActive ? "true" : "false"
      );
    });

  const symbols = atlasParallelMarketSelectedMetals()
    .map(asset => asset.symbol)
    .join(" · ");

  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsTargetSymbols"),
    symbols || "Aucune sélection"
  );

  const visibleRows = [
    ...document.querySelectorAll(
      "[data-metals-market-row]:not([hidden])"
    )
  ].length;

  atlasMetalsStructuralRenderMarketRows();
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderMarketRows();

  const quoteSummary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsMarketStatus"),
    `${visibleRows} actif${visibleRows > 1 ? "s" : ""} visible`
    + `${visibleRows > 1 ? "s" : ""} · ${quoteSummary.market}`
  );

  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsHeaderDecision"),
    `PANIER MÉTAUX ${selected.size}/5 · STRUCTURE ${selected.size}/5`
    + ` · COTATIONS ${quoteSummary.quoteCount}/5`
  );
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsLiveStatus"),
    `Marché Métaux · ${quoteSummary.short}`
  );
}

function atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsDetail() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const baseAsset = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const asset = atlasMarketRegistryAssetMeta(baseAsset.id);
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);

  setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailName"), asset.name);
  setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailSymbol"), asset.symbol);
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailFamily"),
    asset.family.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + asset.family.slice(1)
  );
  setText(document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailUnit"), asset.unit);
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailSelection"),
    selected.has(asset.id) ? "Incluse" : "Hors sélection"
  );
  atlasMarketRegistryRenderSourceDock(asset.id);
  atlasMetalsStructuralRenderActive(asset.id);
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderActive(asset.id);
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderConnectionTruth();
  atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationRenderChart();

  const mode = metals.view === "base100" ? "Base 100" : "Prix";
  const period = atlasChartPeriodLabel(metals.period);
  setText(
    document.getElementById("atlasMetalsChartMode"),
    atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive()
      ? `BASE 100 · ${period.toUpperCase()} · 5/5`
      : `${mode.toUpperCase()} · ${period.toUpperCase()}`
  );

  const status = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDomainStatusText");
  if (status) {
    const count = metals.selectionIds.length;
    const quoteSummary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();
    status.textContent =
      `${count} actif${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} sélectionné`
      + `${count > 1 ? "s" : ""} · ${mode} · ${period} · `
      + quoteSummary.domain;
  }
}

function atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const allSeriesActive = atlasParallelMarketMetalsAllActive();

  const activeMetal = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-id]").forEach(button => {
    const active = selected.has(button.dataset.metalId);
    const focused = button.dataset.metalId === activeMetal.id;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.classList.toggle("is-focus", focused);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    button.setAttribute("aria-current", focused ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-row]").forEach(row => {
    row.hidden = !selected.has(row.dataset.metalRow);
    row.classList.toggle(
      "is-focus",
      row.dataset.metalRow === activeMetal.id
    );
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metal-legend]").forEach(item => {
    const id = String(item.dataset.metalLegend || "");
    const active = selected.has(id);
    const focused = id === activeMetal.id;
    const asset = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.find(record => record.id === id);
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(id, metals.period);
    item.hidden = !active;
    item.classList.toggle("is-focus", focused && !allSeriesActive);
    item.classList.toggle("is-comparison", allSeriesActive);
    item.style.setProperty(
      "--atlas-metal-series-color",
      ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[id] || "#9fb3c2"
    );
    item.textContent = allSeriesActive && reading?.available
      ? `${asset?.symbol || id.toUpperCase()} ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(reading.percent)}`
      : asset?.symbol || id.toUpperCase();
    item.title = reading?.available
      ? `${asset?.name || id} · ${atlasMetalsHumanReadingPercent(reading.percent)} · cliquer pour revenir au prix réel`
      : `${asset?.name || id} · cliquer pour afficher le prix réel`;
  });

  const allSeriesButton = document.querySelector("[data-metals-all-series]");
  if (allSeriesButton) {
    allSeriesButton.classList.toggle("is-active", allSeriesActive);
    allSeriesButton.setAttribute(
      "aria-pressed",
      allSeriesActive ? "true" : "false"
    );
    allSeriesButton.textContent = allSeriesActive ? "TOUS 5/5" : "TOUS";
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-period]").forEach(button => {
    const value = Number(button.dataset.metalsPeriod);
    const active = value === Number(metals.period);
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    const spotReading = value === 1
      ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id, 1)
      : null;
    button.classList.remove("is-unavailable");
    button.classList.toggle("is-building", value === 1 && spotReading?.available !== true);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
    if (value === 1) {
      button.title = spotReading?.available
        ? "Historique 24 h réel · Yahoo Finance Futures intraday"
        : `Intraday Futures en attente · ${spotReading?.detail || "première collecte GitHub Actions requise"}`;
      button.setAttribute(
        "aria-label",
        spotReading?.available
          ? "24 heures mesurées par Yahoo Finance Futures intraday"
          : "Historique Futures intraday 24 heures en attente"
      );
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-view]").forEach(button => {
    const active = button.dataset.metalsView === metals.view;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-section]").forEach(button => {
    const active = button.dataset.metalsSection === metals.section;
    button.classList.toggle("is-active", active);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", active ? "true" : "false");
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-metals-view-panel]").forEach(panel => {
    panel.hidden = panel.dataset.metalsViewPanel !== metals.section;
  });

  const assets = atlasParallelMarketSelectedMetals();
  const symbols = assets.map(asset => asset.symbol).join(" / ");
  const summary = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsSelectionSummary"
  );
  if (summary) {
    summary.textContent = assets.length
      ? `${assets.length} métal${assets.length > 1 ? "x" : ""} `
        + `sélectionné${assets.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} · ${symbols}`
      : "Aucun métal sélectionné";
  }

  const truth = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsFoundationTruth"
  );
  if (truth) {
    const quoteSummary = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary();
    truth.textContent = metals.section === "critical"
      ? "USGS préparé · import structurel non connecté"
      : `${metals.view === "base100" ? "Base 100" : "Prix"} · `
        + `${atlasChartPeriodLabel(metals.period)} · `
        + quoteSummary.truth;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsDetail();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetalsMarket();
  atlasMarketRegistryRenderCatalog();
  if (atlasParallelMarketDomain() === "metals") renderAtlasMathCore();
}

function atlasParallelMarketRender() {
  const domain = atlasParallelMarketDomain();
  const metalsActive = domain === "metals";
  const analyst = document.getElementById("analyste");
  const switchButton = document.getElementById("atlasMarketDomainSwitch");
  const switchValue = document.getElementById("atlasMarketDomainSwitchValue");
  const cryptoToolbar = document.querySelector(
    "#analyste .chart-v2-toolbar"
  );
  const metalsToolbar = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsUnifiedToolbar"
  );
  const foundation = document.getElementById("atlasParallelMarketFoundation");
  const canvas = document.getElementById("mainChart");
  const overlay = document.getElementById("atlasChartInsightOverlay");
  const comparisonSelection = document.getElementById("comparisonSelection");
  const legend = document.getElementById("chartV2Legend");
  const tooltip = document.getElementById("atlasChartTooltip");
  const refresh = document.getElementById("atlasChartRefresh");
  const cryptoDetail = document.getElementById("detailPanel");
  const metalsDetail = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDetailPanel");
  const chartCaption = document.getElementById("chartCaption");
  const metalsStatus = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsDomainStatus");
  const cryptoMarketRibbons = document.getElementById("market-workspace");
  const cryptoMarketGrid = document.getElementById("marketWorkspaceGrid");
  const metalsMarketArea = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsMarketArea");
  const cryptoCommandBar = document.getElementById("livecheck");
  const metalsCommandBar = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsCommandBar");
  const cryptoLiveStatus = document.getElementById("liveStatus");
  const metalsLiveStatus = document.getElementById("atlasMetalsLiveStatus");
  const metalsAnalysisFoundation = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsAnalysisFoundation"
  );

  document.documentElement.dataset.atlasMarketDomain = domain;
  if (analyst) analyst.dataset.marketDomain = domain;
  atlasMetalsMathCorePlace(metalsActive);

  if (cryptoToolbar) {
    cryptoToolbar.hidden = metalsActive;
    cryptoToolbar.setAttribute(
      "aria-hidden",
      metalsActive ? "true" : "false"
    );
  }

  if (metalsToolbar) {
    metalsToolbar.hidden = !metalsActive;
    metalsToolbar.setAttribute(
      "aria-hidden",
      metalsActive ? "false" : "true"
    );
  }

  if (switchButton) {
    switchButton.dataset.domain = domain;
    switchButton.setAttribute("aria-pressed", metalsActive ? "true" : "false");
    switchButton.setAttribute(
      "aria-label",
      metalsActive
        ? "Marché Métaux actif. Cliquer pour revenir au marché Crypto."
        : "Marché Crypto actif. Cliquer pour afficher le marché Métaux."
    );
    switchButton.title = metalsActive
      ? "Marché Métaux · cliquer pour revenir à Crypto"
      : "Marché Crypto · cliquer pour afficher Métaux";
  }

  if (switchValue) {
    switchValue.textContent = metalsActive ? "MÉTAUX" : "CRYPTO";
  }
  if (foundation) foundation.hidden = !metalsActive;
  if (canvas) canvas.hidden = metalsActive;

  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(overlay, metalsActive, "overlay");
  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(
    comparisonSelection,
    metalsActive,
    "comparison"
  );
  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(legend, metalsActive, "legend");
  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(tooltip, metalsActive, "tooltip");
  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(refresh, metalsActive, "refresh");
  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(chartCaption, metalsActive, "caption");

  if (metalsStatus) metalsStatus.hidden = !metalsActive;

  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(
    cryptoCommandBar,
    metalsActive,
    "header-command"
  );
  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(
    cryptoLiveStatus,
    metalsActive,
    "header-live"
  );

  if (metalsCommandBar) {
    metalsCommandBar.hidden = !metalsActive;
  }
  if (metalsLiveStatus) {
    metalsLiveStatus.hidden = !metalsActive;
  }

  if (metalsAnalysisFoundation) {
    metalsAnalysisFoundation.hidden = !metalsActive;
    metalsAnalysisFoundation.setAttribute(
      "aria-hidden",
      metalsActive ? "false" : "true"
    );
  }

  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(
    cryptoMarketRibbons,
    metalsActive,
    "market-ribbons"
  );
  atlasParallelMarketHiddenState(
    cryptoMarketGrid,
    metalsActive,
    "market-grid"
  );
  if (metalsMarketArea) metalsMarketArea.hidden = !metalsActive;

  if (cryptoDetail) {
    if (metalsActive) {
      if (!cryptoDetail.hasAttribute("data-parallel-market-hidden-state")) {
        cryptoDetail.dataset.parallelMarketHiddenState =
          cryptoDetail.hidden ? "1" : "0";
      }
      cryptoDetail.hidden = true;
    } else if (
      cryptoDetail.hasAttribute("data-parallel-market-hidden-state")
    ) {
      cryptoDetail.hidden =
        cryptoDetail.dataset.parallelMarketHiddenState === "1";
      cryptoDetail.removeAttribute("data-parallel-market-hidden-state");
    }
  }

  if (metalsDetail) {
    metalsDetail.hidden = !metalsActive;
    metalsDetail.setAttribute(
      "aria-hidden",
      metalsActive ? "false" : "true"
    );
  }

  if (cryptoDetail) {
    cryptoDetail.setAttribute(
      "aria-hidden",
      metalsActive ? "true" : "false"
    );
  }

  const detailRail = document.getElementById("detailPanelRail");
  if (detailRail) {
    detailRail.setAttribute(
      "aria-hidden",
      metalsActive ? "true" : "false"
    );
    detailRail.tabIndex = metalsActive ? -1 : 0;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketSetControlsDisabled(metalsActive);

  if (metalsActive) {
    atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
    setText(
      document.getElementById("selectedAssetTitle"),
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationSummary().quoteCount > 0
        ? "Marché Métaux — cotations publiques"
        : "Marché Métaux — observation sans cotation"
    );
  } else {
    const coin = getSelectedCoin();
    if (coin) {
      setText(
        document.getElementById("selectedAssetTitle"),
        `${coin.name} — ${coin.symbol}`
      );
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if (typeof atlasRedrawCurrentChartV2 === "function") {
        atlasRedrawCurrentChartV2();
      }
      atlasScheduleStableChartResize({ delay: 180, reason: "parallel-market-return" });
    });
  }

  if (!metalsActive) renderAtlasMathCore();
  atlasWorkspaceRenderStrip?.();
  atlasWorkspaceSlotsRender?.();
  return domain;
}

function atlasParallelMarketSetDomain(domain, options = {}) {
  const next = ATLAS_PARALLEL_MARKET_DOMAINS.includes(domain)
    ? domain
    : "crypto";

  if (next === atlasParallelMarketDomain() && options.force !== true) {
    atlasParallelMarketRender();
    return next;
  }

  if (atlasScannerTransaction || atlasScannerQueuedRequest) {
    atlasScannerCancel(
      "changement de marché parallèle",
      {
        keepUi: false,
        keepOverlay: false
      }
    );
  }

  state.marketDomain = next;

  if (options.persist !== false) {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        ATLAS_PARALLEL_MARKET_DOMAIN_KEY,
        next
      );
    } catch {}
  }

  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  if (next === "metals") {
    void atlasParallelMarketEnsureMetalsRuntime40465(options.source || "operator-domain-metals");
  }
  atlasParallelMarketRender();

  if (options.save !== false) {
    atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  }

  window.dispatchEvent(
    new CustomEvent("atlas:market-domain", {
      detail: {
        domain: next,
        source: options.source || "interface"
      }
    })
  );

  return next;
}

function atlasParallelMarketToggle(source = "interface") {
  return atlasParallelMarketSetDomain(
    atlasParallelMarketDomain() === "crypto"
      ? "metals"
      : "crypto",
    {
      source
    }
  );
}

function atlasParallelMarketToggleMetal(metalId) {
  const id = String(metalId || "");
  const available = new Set(ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => asset.id));
  if (!available.has(id)) return false;

  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  metals.activeId = id;
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);

  if (selected.has(id)) selected.delete(id);
  else selected.add(id);

  metals.selectionIds = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS
    .map(asset => asset.id)
    .filter(assetId => selected.has(assetId));

  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  return true;
}

function atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsPeriod(period) {
  const value = Number(period);
  if (![1, 7, 30, 90, 365].includes(value)) return false;
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period = value;
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceRenderStrip?.();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  void atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationReloadHistory();
  return true;
}

function atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsView(view) {
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().view =
    view === "base100" ? "base100" : "price";
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceRenderStrip?.();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  return true;
}

function atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsSection(section) {
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().section =
    section === "critical" ? "critical" : "prices";
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceRenderStrip?.();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  return true;
}

const atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465 = {
  state: "idle",
  promise: null,
  reason: "",
  startedAt: 0,
  loadedAt: 0,
  lastError: "",
  results: []
};

function atlasParallelMarketEnsureMetalsRuntime40465(reason = "operator") {
  if (atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.state === "ready") {
    return Promise.resolve(true);
  }
  if (atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.promise) {
    return atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.promise;
  }

  atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.state = "loading";
  atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.reason = String(reason || "operator");
  atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.startedAt = Date.now();
  atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.lastError = "";

  const run = async () => {
    // These owners are exclusive to the secondary Metals workspace. 40.4.66
    // keeps them completely out of the default Crypto cold boot, but preserves
    // their exact loaders and fallbacks when Metals is actually requested.
    atlasMetalsCursorInspectorInit();
    atlasMarketRegistryRender();
    atlasMetalsStructuralRenderActive();

    const reportPromise = Promise.resolve(atlasMetalsReportInit());
    const results = await Promise.allSettled([
      reportPromise,
      atlasMarketRegistryLoad(),
      atlasMetalsStructuralLoad(),
      atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationLoad()
    ]);

    atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.results = results.map((row, index) => ({
      owner: ["report-memory", "registry", "structural", "quotes-history"][index],
      status: row.status,
      reason: row.status === "rejected" ? String(row.reason?.message || row.reason || "") : ""
    }));
    atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.loadedAt = Date.now();
    atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.state = "ready";
    atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.lastError = "";

    atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
    if (atlasParallelMarketDomain() === "metals") atlasParallelMarketRender();
    return true;
  };

  atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.promise = run()
    .catch(error => {
      atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.state = "error";
      atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.lastError = String(error?.message || error || "Metals demand runtime");
      console.warn("40.4.66 Metals demand runtime :", error);
      return false;
    })
    .finally(() => {
      atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.promise = null;
    });

  return atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.promise;
}

globalThis.AtlasParallelMarketDemand40465 = Object.freeze({
  build: "40.4.66",
  ensure: atlasParallelMarketEnsureMetalsRuntime40465,
  snapshot: () => ({
    state: atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.state,
    reason: atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.reason,
    started_at: atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.startedAt,
    loaded_at: atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.loadedAt,
    last_error: atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.lastError,
    results: atlasParallelMarketDemandRuntime40465.results.slice(),
    active_domain: atlasParallelMarketDomain(),
    default_crypto_boot_fetches: 0,
    new_timer: false,
    new_observer: false,
    storage_owner_added: false
  })
});

function atlasParallelMarketInit() {
  const switchButton = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMarketDomainSwitch"
  );
  const longPress = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMarketDomainLongPress"
  );
  const foundation = document.getElementById(
    "atlasParallelMarketFoundation"
  );
  const metalsMarketArea = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsMarketArea"
  );
  const metalsToolbar = document.getElementById(
    "atlasMetalsUnifiedToolbar"
  );

  atlasParallelMarketMetalsRead();

  switchButton?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    atlasParallelMarketToggle("domain-badge");
  });

  longPress?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (atlasParallelMarketHoldConsumed) {
      atlasParallelMarketHoldConsumed = false;
    }
  });

  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerdown", event => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return;
    atlasParallelMarketHoldConsumed = false;
    window.clearTimeout(atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer);
    atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer = 0;
      atlasParallelMarketHoldConsumed = true;
      atlasParallelMarketToggle("title-long-press");
    }, ATLAS_PARALLEL_MARKET_HOLD_MS);
  });

  const cancelHold = () => {
    window.clearTimeout(atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer);
    atlasParallelMarketHoldTimer = 0;
  };

  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerup", cancelHold);
  longPress?.addEventListener("pointercancel", cancelHold);
  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerleave", cancelHold);

  longPress?.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
    if (event.shiftKey && ["Enter", " "].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketToggle("title-keyboard");
    }
  });

  metalsMarketArea?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    const card = event.target.closest("[data-metals-market-card]");
    if (card) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetActiveMetal(
        card.dataset.metalsMarketCard
      );
      return;
    }

    const row = event.target.closest("[data-metals-market-row]");
    if (row) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetActiveMetal(
        row.dataset.metalsMarketRow
      );
      return;
    }

    const filter = event.target.closest(
      "[data-metals-market-filter]"
    );
    if (filter) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsMarketFilter(
        filter.dataset.metalsMarketFilter
      );
    }
  });

  metalsToolbar?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    const period = event.target.closest("[data-metals-period]");
    if (period) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsPeriod(
        period.dataset.metalsPeriod
      );
      return;
    }

    const view = event.target.closest("[data-metals-view]");
    if (view) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsView(
        view.dataset.metalsView
      );
      return;
    }

    const section = event.target.closest("[data-metals-section]");
    if (section) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsSection(
        section.dataset.metalsSection
      );
    }
  });

  foundation?.addEventListener("click", event => {
    const allSeries = event.target.closest("[data-metals-all-series]");
    if (allSeries) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketShowAllMetals();
      return;
    }

    const legendItem = event.target.closest("[data-metal-legend]");
    if (legendItem) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetActiveMetal(
        legendItem.dataset.metalLegend
      );
      return;
    }

    const metal = event.target.closest("[data-metal-id]");
    if (metal) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketToggleMetal(metal.dataset.metalId);
      return;
    }

    const row = event.target.closest("[data-metal-row]");
    if (row) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetActiveMetal(row.dataset.metalRow);
      return;
    }

    const period = event.target.closest("[data-metals-period]");
    if (period) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsPeriod(
        period.dataset.metalsPeriod
      );
      return;
    }

    const view = event.target.closest("[data-metals-view]");
    if (view) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsView(
        view.dataset.metalsView
      );
      return;
    }

    const section = event.target.closest("[data-metals-section]");
    if (section) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsSection(
        section.dataset.metalsSection
      );
    }
  });

  state.marketDomain = atlasParallelMarketReadDomain();
  atlasParallelMarketRender();
  if (state.marketDomain === "metals") {
    void atlasParallelMarketEnsureMetalsRuntime40465("restored-metals-domain");
  }
  return true;
}

const ATLAS_METALS_REPORT_SCHEMA = "agent_crypto_metals_public_report_v1";

const ATLAS_METALS_REPORT_STORAGE_SCHEMA = "agent_crypto_metals_public_report_indexeddb_v1";

const ATLAS_METALS_REPORT_DB_NAME = "agent_crypto_metals_public_report_memory_v2";

const ATLAS_METALS_REPORT_STORE = "reports";

const ATLAS_METALS_REPORT_RECORD_ID = "current";

const ATLAS_METALS_REPORT_LIMIT_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

const ATLAS_METALS_REPORT_INTERFACE_PATH = null;

const atlasMetalsReportState = {
  initialized: false,
  package: null,
  source: "none",
  persistence: { ok: false, bytes: 0, error: "Non enregistrée" },
  restorePromise: null,
  operation: 0
};

function atlasMetalsReportClone(value) {
  return value == null ? value : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}

function atlasMetalsReportUtf8Bytes(text) {
  try { return new TextEncoder().encode(String(text || "")).byteLength; }
  catch { return unescape(encodeURIComponent(String(text || ""))).length; }
}

function atlasMetalsReportStableValue(value) {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(atlasMetalsReportStableValue);
  if (value && typeof value === "object") {
    return Object.keys(value).sort().reduce((out, key) => {
      out[key] = atlasMetalsReportStableValue(value[key]);
      return out;
    }, {});
  }
  return value;
}

async function atlasMetalsReportSha256(value) {
  const canonical = JSON.stringify(atlasMetalsReportStableValue(value));
  const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(canonical);
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", bytes);
  return [...new Uint8Array(digest)]
    .map(byte => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, "0"))
    .join("");
}

function atlasMetalsReportIso(value) {
  const raw = String(value || "").trim();
  if (!raw) return null;
  const time = Date.parse(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(time) ? new Date(time).toISOString() : null;
}

function atlasMetalsReportDate(value) {
  const iso = atlasMetalsReportIso(value);
  if (!iso) return "—";
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleString("fr-FR", {
    day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", second: "2-digit"
  });
}

function atlasMetalsReportPrice(quote) {
  return atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPriceText(quote);
}

function atlasMetalsReportPercent(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(number)) return "—";
  return `${number > 0 ? "+" : ""}${new Intl.NumberFormat("fr-FR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2
  }).format(number)} %`;
}

function atlasMetalsReportSnapshotTime(snapshot) {
  return atlasMetalsReportIso(snapshot?.saved_at)
    || atlasMetalsReportIso(snapshot?.quotes?.[0]?.received_at)
    || atlasMetalsReportIso(snapshot?.quotes?.[0]?.source_time)
    || null;
}

function atlasMetalsReportSanitizeCollector(collector) {
  return {
    schema: String(collector?.schema || "agent_crypto_metals_collector_status_v1"),
    status: String(collector?.status || "unknown"),
    provider_id: collector?.provider_id || null,
    provider_name: collector?.provider_name || null,
    last_success_at: atlasMetalsReportIso(collector?.last_success_at),
    assets_expected: Number(collector?.assets_expected || 5),
    assets_received: Number(collector?.assets_received || 0),
    history: atlasMetalsReportClone(collector?.history || null)
  };
}

function atlasMetalsReportHistorySnapshots() {
  const snapshots = Array.isArray(atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.history)
    ? atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationState.history
    : [];
  const map = new Map();
  snapshots.filter(Boolean).forEach(snapshot => {
    const quotes = Array.isArray(snapshot?.quotes) ? snapshot.quotes : [];
    if (!quotes.length || quotes.some(quote => quote?.instrument_type !== "future_continuous")) return;
    const key = String(
      snapshot?.snapshot_id
      || atlasMetalsReportSnapshotTime(snapshot)
      || JSON.stringify(quotes)
    );
    if (key) map.set(key, atlasMetalsReportClone(snapshot));
  });
  return [...map.values()].sort((left, right) => {
    return Date.parse(atlasMetalsReportSnapshotTime(left) || 0)
      - Date.parse(atlasMetalsReportSnapshotTime(right) || 0);
  });
}

function atlasMetalsReportHistoryForAsset(assetId, snapshots) {
  return snapshots.map(snapshot => {
    const quote = (Array.isArray(snapshot?.quotes) ? snapshot.quotes : [])
      .find(row => row?.asset_id === assetId && Number.isFinite(Number(row?.price)));
    if (!quote) return null;
    return {
      time: atlasMetalsReportSnapshotTime(snapshot)
        || atlasMetalsReportIso(quote.received_at)
        || atlasMetalsReportIso(quote.source_time),
      price: Number(quote.price),
      currency: String(quote.currency || "").toUpperCase(),
      unit: String(quote.unit || "")
    };
  }).filter(row => row?.time && Number.isFinite(row.price));
}

function atlasMetalsReportHistoryReading(points) {
  if (points.length < 2) {
    return {
      count: points.length,
      change_percent: null,
      label: points.length === 1
        ? "1 relevé réel · trajectoire non calculable"
        : "aucun relevé historique exploitable"
    };
  }
  const first = points[0];
  const last = points[points.length - 1];
  const change = first.price !== 0
    ? ((last.price - first.price) / first.price) * 100
    : null;
  return {
    count: points.length,
    change_percent: Number.isFinite(change) ? change : null,
    label: Number.isFinite(change)
      ? `${points.length} séances Futures · évolution observée ${atlasMetalsReportPercent(change)}`
      : `${points.length} séances Futures · évolution non calculable`
  };
}

function atlasMetalsReportAssetRows(snapshot, historySnapshots) {
  const quotes = Array.isArray(snapshot?.quotes) ? snapshot.quotes : [];
  return ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(base => {
    const quote = quotes.find(row => row?.asset_id === base.id) || null;
    const structure = atlasMetalsStructuralAsset(base.id) || {};
    const points = atlasMetalsReportHistoryForAsset(base.id, historySnapshots);
    const history = atlasMetalsReportHistoryReading(points);
    return {
      id: base.id,
      name: base.name,
      symbol: base.symbol,
      family: base.family,
      quote: quote ? {
        asset_id: base.id,
        symbol: base.symbol,
        price: Number.isFinite(Number(quote.price)) ? Number(quote.price) : null,
        price_eur: Number.isFinite(Number(quote.price_eur)) ? Number(quote.price_eur) : null,
        fx_source_date: quote.fx_source_date || null,
        currency: String(quote.currency || "").toUpperCase(),
        unit: String(quote.unit || ""),
        change_percent:
          quote.change_percent !== null
          && quote.change_percent !== undefined
          && quote.change_percent !== ""
          && Number.isFinite(Number(quote.change_percent))
            ? Number(quote.change_percent)
            : null,
        data_state: String(quote.data_state || "unknown"),
        source_id: quote.source_id || quote.provider_id || null,
        source_name: quote.source_name || quote.provider_name || null,
        source_time: atlasMetalsReportIso(quote.source_time),
        received_at: atlasMetalsReportIso(quote.received_at)
      } : null,
      history,
      history_points: points,
      structure: {
        production: String(structure?.production?.display || "—"),
        reserves: String(structure?.reserves?.display || "—"),
        producers: String(structure?.production?.top_display || "—"),
        uses: String(structure?.uses?.display || "—"),
        eu_status: String(structure?.eu_status?.display || "—"),
        source_ids: Array.isArray(structure?.source_ids)
          ? [...structure.source_ids]
          : []
      }
    };
  });
}

function atlasMetalsReportWarnings(assets, snapshot, historySnapshots) {
  const warnings = [];
  const delayed = assets.filter(asset => asset.quote?.data_state === "data_delayed");
  if (delayed.length) {
    warnings.push(`Cotations différées : ${delayed.map(asset => asset.symbol).join(" / ")}.`);
  }
  const missing = assets.filter(asset => !Number.isFinite(Number(asset.quote?.price)));
  if (missing.length) {
