function atlasLearningMemoryEligibleArchive(entry) {
  return Boolean(
    entry
    && entry.completed_at
    && entry.session_id
    && ATLAS_AUTOMATIC_LEARNING_MEMORY_MODULES.includes(String(entry.module_key || ""))
  );
}

function atlasLearningMemoryArchives() {
  return loadLearningHistory()
    .filter(atlasLearningMemoryEligibleArchive)
    .sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a.completed_at || a.archived_at || 0) - Date.parse(b.completed_at || b.archived_at || 0));
}

function atlasLearningMemoryAnswerTrace(evidence, prefix, correctValue) {
  const first = String(evidence?.[`${prefix}_first_choice`] ?? evidence?.[`${prefix}_first_answer`] ?? "").trim();
  const attempts = Math.max(0, Number(evidence?.[`${prefix}_attempts`] || 0));
  if (!first && !attempts) return "aucune première tentative distincte enregistrée";
  const normalizedCorrect = String(correctValue ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  const firstCorrect = String(first).trim().toLowerCase() === normalizedCorrect;
  return `${first || "—"} · ${firstCorrect ? "correcte" : "corrigée ensuite"}${attempts > 1 ? ` · ${attempts} tentatives` : ""}`;
}

function atlasLearningMemoryArchiveSummary(entry) {
  const evidence = entry?.practice_evidence || {};
  const completed = entry?.completed_at || entry?.archived_at || null;
  const when = completed ? new Date(completed).toLocaleString("fr-FR") : "heure non disponible";
  if (entry?.module_key === "market") {
    const prefill = evidence.market_archive_prefill || {};
    const observation = prefill.observation || evidence.market_btc_read || {};
    const provenance = prefill.provenance || evidence.market_source_time || {};
    const price = Number(observation.price_eur);
    const change24 = Number(observation.change_24h_pct);
    const change7 = Number(observation.change_7d_pct);
    const firstAnswer = String(evidence.market_prediction_first_answer || "").trim().toLowerCase();
    const firstTrace = firstAnswer
      ? `${firstAnswer === "non" ? "Non · correcte" : "Oui · corrigée ensuite"}${Number(evidence.market_prediction_attempts || 0) > 1 ? ` · ${Number(evidence.market_prediction_attempts)} tentatives` : ""}`
      : "aucune première tentative distincte enregistrée";
    return [
      "MODULE 01 · MARCHÉ ET DONNÉES",
      `Archivé : ${when}`,
      "",
      "Ce que j’ai observé :",
      `- Bitcoin : ${Number.isFinite(price) ? fmtEUR.format(price) : "valeur non disponible"}.`,
      `- Variation 24 h : ${Number.isFinite(change24) ? atlasSignedPct(change24) : "non disponible"}.`,
      `- Variation 7 j : ${Number.isFinite(change7) ? atlasSignedPct(change7) : "non disponible"}.`,
      `- Source : ${String(provenance.source || "non disponible")}.`,
      `- Heure des données : ${String(provenance.displayed_time || provenance.time || "non disponible")}.`,
      "",
      "Rappel actif :",
      `- Première réponse à « peut-on prédire avec certitude ? » : ${firstTrace}.`,
      "- Réponse finale validée : Non.",
      "",
      "À retenir : une observation datée décrit le marché ; elle ne prédit pas avec certitude son prochain mouvement."
    ].join("\n");
  }
  if (entry?.module_key === "spot") {
    const prefill = evidence.spot_archive_prefill || {};
    const orderbook = prefill.orderbook || {};
    const sim = prefill.simulation || evidence.spot_position_details || {};
    const ask = Number(orderbook.best_ask_eur || (evidence.spot_best_ask ? 60010 : NaN));
    const bid = Number(orderbook.best_bid_eur || (evidence.spot_best_bid ? 59990 : NaN));
    const spread = Number(orderbook.spread_eur || (Number.isFinite(ask) && Number.isFinite(bid) ? ask - bid : NaN));
    const amount = Number(sim.amount_eur ?? evidence.spot_position_details?.amount_eur);
    const entryPrice = Number(sim.entry_price_eur ?? evidence.spot_position_details?.entry_price_eur);
    const quantity = Number(sim.quantity_btc ?? evidence.spot_position_details?.quantity);
    const cash = Number(sim.cash_remaining_eur ?? evidence.spot_position_details?.cash_remaining_eur);
    return [
      "MODULE 02 · SPOT ET CARNET D’ORDRES",
      `Archivé : ${when}`,
      "",
      "Ce que j’ai appris :",
      `- Meilleur Ask : ${Number.isFinite(ask) ? fmtEUR.format(ask) : "non disponible"}.`,
      `- Meilleur Bid : ${Number.isFinite(bid) ? fmtEUR.format(bid) : "non disponible"}.`,
      `- Spread pédagogique : ${Number.isFinite(spread) ? fmtEUR.format(spread) : "non disponible"}.`,
      "- Ordre au marché : priorité à l’exécution.",
      "- Ordre limite : priorité au prix choisi ; exécution non garantie.",
      "",
      "Simulation fictive :",
      `- Montant placé : ${Number.isFinite(amount) ? fmtEUR.format(amount) : "non disponible"}.`,
      `- Prix d’entrée : ${Number.isFinite(entryPrice) ? fmtEUR.format(entryPrice) : "non disponible"}.`,
      `- Quantité BTC : ${Number.isFinite(quantity) ? quantity.toFixed(8) : "non disponible"}.`,
      `- Argent disponible après simulation : ${Number.isFinite(cash) ? fmtEUR.format(cash) : "non disponible"}.`,
      `- Source : ${String(sim.quote_source || evidence.spot_position_details?.quote_source || "non disponible")}.`,
      `- Heure de cotation : ${String(sim.quote_timestamp || evidence.spot_position_details?.quote_timestamp || "non disponible")}.`,
      "",
      "Traces de rappel actif :",
      `- Ask : ${atlasLearningMemoryAnswerTrace(evidence, "spot_ask", "60010")}.`,
      `- Bid : ${atlasLearningMemoryAnswerTrace(evidence, "spot_bid", "59990")}.`,
      `- Marché : ${atlasLearningMemoryAnswerTrace(evidence, "spot_market", "market")}.`,
      `- Limite : ${atlasLearningMemoryAnswerTrace(evidence, "spot_limit", "limit")}.`,
      `- Question finale : ${atlasLearningMemoryAnswerTrace(evidence, "spot_limit_guarantee", "non")}.`,
      "",
      "À retenir : une partie du capital virtuel devient une position BTC fictive ; l’argent disponible baisse du même montant au moment de l’achat simulé."
    ].join("\n");
  }
  const generic = ATLAS_AUTOMATIC_LEARNING_MEMORY_GENERIC[entry?.module_key];
  if (generic) {
    const guidedSummary = String(evidence[generic.summaryKey] || entry?.takeaway || "Synthèse guidée non disponible dans cette archive historique.").trim();
    const finalTrace = atlasLearningMemoryAnswerTrace(evidence, generic.finalPrefix, generic.correct);
    const proofLines = generic.proofs
      .filter(([key]) => evidence?.[key])
      .map(([, label]) => `- ${label} : preuve enregistrée.`);
    return [
      `MODULE ${generic.number} · ${String(entry?.module_title || learningModuleByKey(entry?.module_key)?.title || entry?.module_key || "MODULE").replace(/^\d+ · /, "").toUpperCase()}`,
      `Archivé : ${when}`,
      "",
      "Ce que j’ai appris :",
      guidedSummary,
      "",
      "Preuves conservées :",
      ...(proofLines.length ? proofLines : ["- archive historique : preuves détaillées non disponibles dans ce format."]),
      "",
      "Rappel actif :",
      `- Première réponse : ${finalTrace}.`,
      `- Réponse finale attendue et validée : ${generic.correct === "oui" ? "Oui" : "Non"}.`,
      "",
      "Sécurité : aucune opération réelle n’est déclenchée par cette mémoire pédagogique."
    ].join("\n");
  }
  return "Archive pédagogique non prise en charge par la mémoire automatique actuelle.";
}

function buildAutomaticLearningJournalMarkdown() {
  const archives = atlasLearningMemoryArchives();
  if (!archives.length) {
    return [
      "# JOURNAL PÉDAGOGIQUE AUTOMATIQUE — Agent-Crypto @erith.IA",
      "",
      `Version : ${ATLAS_RELEASE}`,
      `Date : ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
      "",
      "Aucun module du parcours 01 à 11 n’est encore archivé dans le carnet IndexedDB.",
      "Aucune action supplémentaire n’est requise : le prochain archivage compatible remplira ce journal automatiquement.",
      "",
      "Sécurité : aucune clé API, aucun wallet, aucun ordre réel."
    ].join("\n");
  }
  const recent = archives.slice(-3).reverse();
  return [
    "# JOURNAL PÉDAGOGIQUE AUTOMATIQUE — Agent-Crypto @erith.IA",
    "",
    `Version : ${ATLAS_RELEASE}`,
    `Généré : ${new Date().toISOString()}`,
    `Modules pédagogiques mémorisés ici : ${archives.length}`,
    "",
    "Le journal ci-dessous est reconstruit automatiquement depuis les archives pédagogiques vérifiées. Il affiche les trois sessions les plus récentes ; toutes les archives restent conservées. Aucun clic de résumé n’est nécessaire.",
    "",
    ...recent.flatMap((entry, index) => [
      index ? "---" : "",
      atlasLearningMemoryArchiveSummary(entry),
      ""
    ]),
    "Sécurité : mémoire locale dérivée des preuves pédagogiques ; aucune clé API, aucun wallet, aucun ordre réel."
  ].filter(Boolean).join("\n");
}

function atlasLearningMemoryRecordFromArchive(entry) {
  if (!atlasLearningMemoryEligibleArchive(entry)) return null;
  const evidence = entry.practice_evidence || {};
  const moduleKey = String(entry.module_key || "");
  const savedAt = entry.completed_at || entry.archived_at || new Date().toISOString();
  const sessionId = String(entry.session_id);
  const startCash = Number(SIM_PROFILE.startCash || 0);
  let source = "archive pédagogique IndexedDB";
  let symbols = [];
  let cash = startCash;
  let exposure = 0;
  let total = startCash;
  const moduleIndex = ATLAS_FOUNDATION_MODULE_KEYS.indexOf(moduleKey) + 1;
  let learningTags = [`module_${String(moduleIndex || 0).padStart(2, "0")}`, "archive_pedagogique", "memoire_automatique"];
  let evidencePayload = {};

  if (moduleKey === "market") {
    const prefill = evidence.market_archive_prefill || {};
    source = String(prefill?.provenance?.source || evidence.market_source_time?.source || source);
    symbols = ["BTC"];
    learningTags.push("market_learning", "source_verified", "active_recall");
    evidencePayload = prefill;
  } else if (moduleKey === "spot") {
    const prefill = evidence.spot_archive_prefill || {};
    const sim = prefill.simulation || evidence.spot_position_details || {};
    source = String(sim.quote_source || source);
    symbols = ["BTC"];
    cash = Number.isFinite(Number(sim.cash_remaining_eur)) ? Number(sim.cash_remaining_eur) : startCash;
    exposure = Number.isFinite(Number(sim.amount_eur)) ? Number(sim.amount_eur) : 0;
    total = cash + exposure;
    learningTags.push("ask_bid", "market_limit", "achat_simule", "active_recall");
    evidencePayload = prefill;
  } else {
    const generic = ATLAS_AUTOMATIC_LEARNING_MEMORY_GENERIC[moduleKey] || null;
    if (moduleKey === "risk") {
      const details = evidence.risk_position_details || {};
      symbols = ["BTC"];
      cash = Number.isFinite(Number(details.cash_remaining_eur)) ? Number(details.cash_remaining_eur) : startCash;
      exposure = Number.isFinite(Number(details.amount_eur)) ? Number(details.amount_eur) : 0;
      total = cash + exposure;
    }
    if (generic) {
      learningTags.push(...generic.tags);
      evidencePayload = {
        guided_summary:String(evidence[generic.summaryKey] || entry?.takeaway || ""),
        final_recall:{
          correct_answer:generic.correct,
          first_answer:String(evidence[`${generic.finalPrefix}_first_answer`] || evidence[`${generic.finalPrefix}_first_choice`] || ""),
          attempts:Number(evidence[`${generic.finalPrefix}_attempts`] || 0)
        },
        proof_keys:generic.proofs.filter(([key]) => Boolean(evidence[key])).map(([key]) => key)
      };
    }
  }

  return {
    id:`learning_${sessionId}`,
    snapshot_id:`learning_${sessionId}`,
    saved_at:savedAt,
    version:ATLAS_RELEASE,
    public_only:true,
    auto_generated:true,
    collection_kind:"learning_archive_auto",
    collector_type:"learning_archive",
    source,
    live_ok:false,
    symbols,
    learning_tags:[...new Set(learningTags)],
    learning_session_id:sessionId,
    learning_module_key:moduleKey,
    learning_module_title:String(entry.module_title || learningModuleByKey(moduleKey).title || moduleKey),
    learning_summary:atlasLearningMemoryArchiveSummary(entry),
    learning_payload:{
      schema:ATLAS_AUTOMATIC_LEARNING_MEMORY_SCHEMA,
      module_key:moduleKey,
      session_id:sessionId,
      completed_at:entry.completed_at || null,
      archived_at:entry.archived_at || null,
      evidence:evidencePayload,
      safety:{ real_order:false, api_key:false, wallet:false }
    },
    snapshot:{
      generated_at:savedAt,
      version:ATLAS_RELEASE,
      public_only:true,
      profile:{
        profile:String(entry.profile_label || SIM_PROFILE.label),
        start_cash_eur:startCash,
        cash_eur:cash,
        current_exposure_eur:exposure
      },
      simulation:{ logs:[] },
      totals:{ cash_eur:cash, positions_value_eur:exposure, total_value_eur:total, pnl_eur:0 },
      market_snapshot:{ live_ok:false, source, assets:[] }
    }
  };
}

async function syncArchivedLearningMemoryToCollector(options = {}) {
  await atlasCollectorInitializeStorage();
  const archives = atlasLearningMemoryArchives();
  if (!archives.length) {
    renderAutomaticLearningMemoryPanels();
    return { ok:true, added:0, total:readCollectorMemory().length, eligible:0, backend:atlasCollectorStorageMode };
  }
  const records = readCollectorMemory();
  let added = 0;
  let updated = 0;
  for (const archive of archives) {
    const sessionId = String(archive.session_id || "");
    if (!sessionId) continue;
    const record = atlasLearningMemoryRecordFromArchive(archive);
    if (!record) continue;
    const existingIndex = records.findIndex(item => String(item?.learning_session_id || "") === sessionId);
    if (existingIndex < 0) {
      records.push(record);
      added += 1;
      continue;
    }
    const existing = records[existingIndex];
    if (JSON.stringify(existing) !== JSON.stringify(record)) {
      records[existingIndex] = record;
      updated += 1;
    }
  }
  try {
    if (added || updated) {
      writeCollectorMemory(records, "learning_archive_reconcile");
      const persisted = await atlasCollectorPersistNow("learning_archive_reconcile_verified");
      if (!persisted.ok) throw new Error(persisted.error_message || persisted.error_name || "écriture IndexedDB non vérifiée");
    }
    renderAutomaticLearningMemoryPanels();
    return { ok:true, added, updated, total:readCollectorMemory().length, eligible:archives.length, backend:atlasCollectorStorageMode };
  } catch (error) {
    renderAutomaticLearningMemoryPanels();
    if (els.collectorOutput) {
      els.collectorOutput.textContent = [
        "MÉMOIRE PÉDAGOGIQUE CONSERVÉE · COPIE DATA COLLECTOR DIFFÉRÉE",
        "",
        "L’archive pédagogique IndexedDB reste valide. La mémoire secondaire n’a pas pu être confirmée.",
        `Détail : ${cleanError(error)}`,
        "",
        "Aucune séance pédagogique n’est invalidée et aucune donnée n’est inventée."
      ].join("\n");
    }
    return { ok:false, added:0, updated:0, total:readCollectorMemory().length, eligible:archives.length, backend:atlasCollectorStorageMode, error:cleanError(error) };
  }
}

function renderAutomaticLearningMemoryPanels() {
  if (els.simLearningOutput) els.simLearningOutput.textContent = buildAutomaticLearningJournalMarkdown();
  const records = readCollectorMemory();
  renderCollectorStatus();
  if (els.collectorOutput) els.collectorOutput.textContent = collectorPreview(records);
  if (els.memoryExplorerOutput) els.memoryExplorerOutput.textContent = exploreMemoryText(records);
  renderCollectionProgress();
  if (els.collectionPlanOutput) els.collectionPlanOutput.textContent = collectionPlanText(records);
  renderResumeAssistantStatus();
}

const COLLECTOR_STORAGE_KEY = "agent_crypto_erith_ia_collector_v1_1_alpha_13"; // legacy LocalStorage only
const COLLECTOR_MAX_RECORDS = 500;
const COLLECTOR_DB_NAME = "agent_crypto_local_memory";
const COLLECTOR_DB_VERSION = 1;
const COLLECTOR_DB_STORE = "memory";
const COLLECTOR_DB_RECORD_ID = "collector_memory_primary";
const COLLECTOR_DB_SCHEMA = "agent_crypto_collector_indexeddb_v1";
let atlasCollectorMemoryCache = [];
let atlasCollectorStorageReady = false;
let atlasCollectorStorageInitPromise = null;
let atlasCollectorStorageMode = "starting";
let atlasCollectorStorageDirty = false;
let atlasCollectorStoragePersistTimer = 0;
let atlasCollectorStorageWriteChain = Promise.resolve();
let atlasCollectorStorageLastResult = { ok:false, backend:"IndexedDB", status:"not_started" };

function atlasCollectorClone(value) {
  if (value === undefined) return undefined;
  try { return structuredClone(value); } catch {}
  return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}

function atlasCollectorRecordIdentity(record) {
  const learningId = String(record?.learning_session_id || "").trim();
  if (learningId) return `learning:${learningId}`;
  const collector = String(record?.collector_id || "local").trim();
  const canonical = atlasMemoryCanonicalSnapshotId(record);
  if (canonical) return `market:${collector}:${canonical}`;
  return `record:${String(record?.snapshot_id || record?.id || record?.saved_at || atlasLegacyLearningHash(JSON.stringify(record || {})))}`;
}

function atlasCollectorNormalizeRecords(records) {
  const list = Array.isArray(records) ? records.filter(record => record && typeof record === "object") : [];
  const ordered = list.slice().sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a?.saved_at || 0) - Date.parse(b?.saved_at || 0));
  const map = new Map();
  for (const record of ordered) map.set(atlasCollectorRecordIdentity(record), atlasCollectorClone(record));
  return [...map.values()].sort((a, b) => Date.parse(a?.saved_at || 0) - Date.parse(b?.saved_at || 0)).slice(-COLLECTOR_MAX_RECORDS);
}

function atlasCollectorLegacyLocalStorageRecords() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(COLLECTOR_STORAGE_KEY);
    const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : [];
    return atlasCollectorNormalizeRecords(parsed);
  } catch { return []; }
}

function atlasCollectorDbRequest(request) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error("requête IndexedDB Collector refusée"));
  });
}

function atlasCollectorDbTransactionDone(transaction) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve(true);
    transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error("transaction IndexedDB Collector refusée"));
    transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error("transaction IndexedDB Collector annulée"));
  });
}

function atlasCollectorDbOpen() {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (typeof indexedDB === "undefined") return reject(new Error("IndexedDB indisponible dans ce navigateur"));
    const request = indexedDB.open(COLLECTOR_DB_NAME, COLLECTOR_DB_VERSION);
    request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
      const db = request.result;
      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(COLLECTOR_DB_STORE)) db.createObjectStore(COLLECTOR_DB_STORE, { keyPath:"id" });
    };
    request.onsuccess = () => {
      const db = request.result;
      db.onversionchange = () => db.close();
      resolve(db);
    };
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error || new Error("ouverture IndexedDB Collector refusée"));
    request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error("IndexedDB Collector bloquée par un autre onglet"));
  });
}

async function atlasCollectorDbReadRecord() {
  const db = await atlasCollectorDbOpen();
  try {
    const tx = db.transaction(COLLECTOR_DB_STORE, "readonly");
    const done = atlasCollectorDbTransactionDone(tx);
    const record = await atlasCollectorDbRequest(tx.objectStore(COLLECTOR_DB_STORE).get(COLLECTOR_DB_RECORD_ID));
    await done;
    return record || null;
  } finally { db.close(); }
}

function atlasCollectorPayload(records = atlasCollectorMemoryCache) {
  const safe = atlasCollectorNormalizeRecords(records);
  return {
    id:COLLECTOR_DB_RECORD_ID,
    schema:COLLECTOR_DB_SCHEMA,
    build:ATLAS_BUILD,
    records:safe,
    updated_at:new Date().toISOString()
  };
}

function atlasCollectorDigest(records) {
  return atlasLegacyLearningHash(JSON.stringify(atlasCollectorNormalizeRecords(records)));
}

async function atlasCollectorDbWriteVerified(records, reason = "collector_save") {
  const payload = atlasCollectorPayload(records);
  const expectedDigest = atlasCollectorDigest(payload.records);
  const db = await atlasCollectorDbOpen();
  try {
    const tx = db.transaction(COLLECTOR_DB_STORE, "readwrite");
    const done = atlasCollectorDbTransactionDone(tx);
    await atlasCollectorDbRequest(tx.objectStore(COLLECTOR_DB_STORE).put(payload));
    await done;
  } finally { db.close(); }
  const reread = await atlasCollectorDbReadRecord();
  const actualDigest = atlasCollectorDigest(reread?.records || []);
  if (actualDigest !== expectedDigest) throw new Error("relecture IndexedDB Collector différente de l’écriture");
  return { ok:true, backend:"IndexedDB", reason, digest:actualDigest, count:(reread?.records || []).length };
}

async function atlasCollectorPersistNow(reason = "collector_save") {
  clearTimeout(atlasCollectorStoragePersistTimer);
  atlasCollectorStoragePersistTimer = 0;
  if (!atlasCollectorStorageReady || atlasCollectorStorageMode === "legacy_fallback") {
    return { ok:false, backend:atlasCollectorStorageMode, error_name:"CollectorStorageUnavailable", error_message:"Mémoire Collector IndexedDB non disponible", reason };
  }
  atlasCollectorStorageDirty = false;
  const snapshot = atlasCollectorClone(atlasCollectorMemoryCache);
  const execute = async () => {
    try {
      const result = await atlasCollectorDbWriteVerified(snapshot, reason);
      atlasCollectorStorageLastResult = result;
      return result;
    } catch (error) {
      const result = { ok:false, backend:"IndexedDB", reason, error_name:String(error?.name || "IndexedDBError"), error_message:String(error?.message || error) };
      atlasCollectorStorageLastResult = result;
      return result;
    }
  };
  atlasCollectorStorageWriteChain = atlasCollectorStorageWriteChain.catch(() => null).then(execute);
  return atlasCollectorStorageWriteChain;
}

function atlasCollectorSchedulePersist(reason = "collector_update") {
  atlasCollectorStorageDirty = true;
  clearTimeout(atlasCollectorStoragePersistTimer);
  atlasCollectorStoragePersistTimer = window.setTimeout(() => { void atlasCollectorPersistNow(reason); }, 180);
}

function atlasCollectorFlushScheduledPersist(reason = "pagehide") {
  if (!atlasCollectorStorageDirty) return Promise.resolve({ ok:true, skipped:true, reason });
  return atlasCollectorPersistNow(reason);
}

async function atlasCollectorInitializeStorage() {
  if (atlasCollectorStorageReady) return atlasCollectorMemoryCache;
  if (atlasCollectorStorageInitPromise) return atlasCollectorStorageInitPromise;
  atlasCollectorStorageInitPromise = (async () => {
    const legacy = atlasCollectorLegacyLocalStorageRecords();
    try {
      const stored = await atlasCollectorDbReadRecord();
      const storedRaw = Array.isArray(stored?.records) ? stored.records : [];
      const existing = atlasCollectorNormalizeRecords(storedRaw);
      const merged = atlasCollectorNormalizeRecords([...legacy, ...existing]);
      atlasCollectorMemoryCache = merged;
      atlasCollectorStorageReady = true;
      atlasCollectorStorageMode = "indexeddb";
      const storedNeedsCanonicalRewrite = storedRaw.length !== existing.length;
      const needsWrite = !stored || storedNeedsCanonicalRewrite || atlasCollectorDigest(existing) !== atlasCollectorDigest(merged);
      if (needsWrite) {
        const migrated = await atlasCollectorPersistNow(legacy.length ? "legacy_localstorage_migration" : "collector_indexeddb_init");
        if (!migrated.ok) throw new Error(migrated.error_message || "migration Collector non vérifiée");
      }
      // On supprime l'ancien LocalStorage uniquement après relecture IndexedDB conforme.
      if (legacy.length) {
        const reread = await atlasCollectorDbReadRecord();
        if (atlasCollectorDigest(reread?.records || []) === atlasCollectorDigest(merged)) {
          try { localStorage.removeItem(COLLECTOR_STORAGE_KEY); } catch {}
        }
      }
      atlasCollectorStorageLastResult = { ok:true, backend:"IndexedDB", status:legacy.length ? "migrated" : "ready", count:merged.length };
      return atlasCollectorMemoryCache;
    } catch (error) {
      atlasCollectorMemoryCache = legacy;
      atlasCollectorStorageReady = true;
      atlasCollectorStorageMode = "legacy_fallback";
      atlasCollectorStorageLastResult = { ok:false, backend:"legacy_fallback", status:"read_only_fallback", error_name:String(error?.name || "IndexedDBError"), error_message:String(error?.message || error), count:legacy.length };
      return atlasCollectorMemoryCache;
    }
  }

  if (state.marketDomain === "metals") {
    void atlasParallelMarketEnsureMetalsRuntime40465("restored-metals-domain");
  }
  return true;
}

  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerup", cancelHold);
  longPress?.addEventListener("pointercancel", cancelHold);
  longPress?.addEventListener("pointerleave", cancelHold);

    if (event.shiftKey && ["Enter", " "].includes(event.key)) {
      event.preventDefault();
      atlasParallelMarketToggle("title-keyboard");

rows.length;
  const variance = rows.reduce(
    (sum, value) => sum + (value - mean) ** 2,

  return Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, variance));

function atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points) {
  if (!Array.isArray(points) || points.length < 2) return null;
  let peak = points[0];
  let peakIndex = 0;
  let maxPct = 0;
  let start = points[0];
  let trough = points[0];
  points.forEach((point, index) => {
    if (point.y > peak.y) {
      peak = point;
      peakIndex = index;
    }
    const pct = peak.y > 0 ? ((peak.y - point.y) / peak.y) * 100 : 0;
    if (pct > maxPct) {
      maxPct = pct;
      start = points[peakIndex];
      trough = point;
    }
  });
  return { pct: maxPct, start, trough };
}

function atlasMetalsMathCoreMetrics() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const asset = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal();
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 7);
  const periodLabel = atlasChartPeriodLabel(periodDays);
  const rows = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationPeriodRows(periodDays);
  const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
  const returns = [];
  for (let index = 1; index < points.length; index += 1) {
    const previous = Number(points[index - 1].y);
    const current = Number(points[index].y);
    if (previous > 0 && current > 0) returns.push(Math.log(current / previous));
  }
  const volatilitySessionPct = returns.length >= 2
    ? atlasMetalsMathSampleStd(returns) * 100
    : null;
  const drawdown = atlasMetalsMathDrawdown(points);
  const values = points.map(point => Number(point.y)).filter(Number.isFinite);
  const low = values.length ? Math.min(...values) : null;
  const high = values.length ? Math.max(...values) : null;
  const amplitudePct = Number.isFinite(low) && low > 0 && Number.isFinite(high)
    ? ((high - low) / low) * 100
    : null;
  const completenessPct = rows.length
    ? Math.min(100, (points.length / rows.length) * 100)
    : null;
  const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, periodDays);
  const quote = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationQuote(asset.id);
  const first = points[0] || null;
  const last = points[points.length - 1] || null;
  const latestStepPct = points.length >= 2
    ? ((points[points.length - 1].y / points[points.length - 2].y) - 1) * 100
    : null;
  return {
    asset,
    periodDays,
    periodLabel,
    rows,
    p

sParallelMarketDomain() {
  return ATLAS_PARALLEL_MARKET_DOMAINS.includes(state.marketDomain)
    ? state.marketDomain
    : "crypto";
}

function atlasParallelMarketMetalsState() {
  return state.parallelMarkets.metals;
}

function atlasParallelMarketValidMetalIds(ids) {
  const available = new Set(ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => asset.id));
  const normalized = Array.isArray(ids)
    ? ids
        .map(id => String(id || ""))
        .filter(id => available.has(id))
        .filter((id, index, list) => list.indexOf(id) === index)
        .slice(0, ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length)
    : [];

  return normalized.length
    ? normalized
    : ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => asset.id);
}

function atlasParallelMarketMetalsRead() {
  const saved = atlasParallelMarketSafeRead(
    ATLAS_PARALLEL_MARKET_METALS_STATE_KEY
  );
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  if (!saved) {
    metals.period = 7;
    metals.resultVisibilityVersion = "28.2.62";
    return metals;
  }

  metals.period = [1, 7, 30, 90, 365].includes(Number(saved.period))
    ? Number(saved.period)
    : 7;
  const visibilityMigrated = String(saved.resultVisibilityVersion || "") === "28.2.61";
  if (!visibilityMigrated && metals.period === 1) metals.period = 7;
  metals.resultVisibilityVersion = "28.2.62";
  metals.view = saved.view === "base100" ? "base100" : "price";
  metals.scale = saved.scale === "logarithmic"
    ? "logarithmic"
    : "linear";
  metals.section = saved.section === "critical"
    ? "critical"
    : "prices";
  metals.activeId = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.some(
    asset => asset.id === String(saved.activeId || "")
  )
    ? String(saved.activeId)
    : "gold";
  metals.marketFilter = [
    "all",
    "monetary",
    "precious-industrial",
    "industrial"
  ].includes(String(saved.marketFilter || ""))
    ? String(saved.marketFilter)
    : "all";
  metals.selectionIds = atlasParallelMarketValidMetalIds(
    saved.selectionIds
  );
  if (!visibilityMigrated) atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  return metals;
}

function atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const payload = {
    schema: "agent_crypto_parallel_market_metals_state_v1",
    savedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    period: Number(metals.period || 7),
    resultVisibilityVersion: "28.2.61",
    view: metals.view === "base100" ? "base100" : "price",
    scale: metals.scale === "logarithmic"
      ? "logarithmic"
      : "linear",
    section: metals.section === "critical"
      ? "critical"
      : "prices",
    activeId: ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.some(
      asset => asset.id === String(metals.activeId || "")
    )
      ? String(metals.activeId)
      : "gold",
    marketFilter: [
      "all",
      "monetary",
      "precious-industrial",
      "industrial"
    ].includes(String(metals.marketFilter || ""))
      ? String(metals.marketFilter)
      : "all",
    selectionIds: [...metals.selectionIds]
  };

  try {
    localStorage.setItem(
      ATLAS_PARALLEL_MARKET_METALS_STATE_KEY,
      JSON.stringify(payload)
    );
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationChartSeries() {
  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);
  const activeId = atlasParallelMarketActiveMetal().id;
  const periodDays = Number(metals.period || 365);
  const series = [];

  for (const asset of ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS) {
    if (!selected.has(asset.id)) continue;
    // Les unités et ordres de grandeur diffèrent fortement.
    // En mode Prix, une seule échelle réelle est affichée : l'actif actif.
    // La comparaison multi-actifs est réservée au mode Base 100.
    if (metals.view !== "base100" && asset.id !== activeId) continue;
    const points = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationAssetPoints(asset.id, periodDays);
    if (!points.length) continue;
    if (metals.view === "base100") {
      const base = points[0].y;
      points.forEach(point => { point.y = (point.y / base) * 100; });
    }
    series.push({
      id: asset.id,
      symbol: asset.symbol,
      color: ATLAS_METALS_CHART_COLORS[asset.id],
      points
    });
  }
  return series;
}

    ? Math.max(0, (points[points.length - 1].x - points[0].x) / 3600000)
    : 0;

  if (points.length < 2) {
    const count = points.length;
    return Object.freeze({
      available: false,
      partial: intraday && count > 0,
      state: "insufficient",

function atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationComparison(periodDays = null) {
  const days = Number(
    periodDays ?? atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period ?? 7
  );
  const rows = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => {
    const reading = atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationHorizonReading(asset.id, days);
    return Object.freeze({
      asset,
      reading,
      available: reading?.available === true,
      percent: reading?.available === true
        ? Number(reading.percent)
        : null
    });
  });
  const available = rows
    .filter(row => row.available && Number.isFinite(row.percent))
    .sort((left, right) => right.percent - left.percent);
  const leader = available[0] || null;
  const laggard = available[available.length - 1] || null;
  const spread = leader && laggard
    ? leader.percent - laggard.percent
    : null;
  return Object.freeze({
    days,
    rows: Object.freeze(rows),
    available: Object.freeze(available),
    count: available.length,
    complete: available.length === ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.length,
    leader,
    laggard,
    spread
  });
}

function atlasParallelMarketToggleMetal(metalId) {
  const id = String(metalId || "");
  const available = new Set(ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS.map(asset => asset.id));
  if (!available.has(id)) return false;

  const metals = atlasParallelMarketMetalsState();
  metals.activeId = id;
  const selected = new Set(metals.selectionIds);

  if (selected.has(id)) selected.delete(id);
  else selected.add(id);

  metals.selectionIds = ATLAS_METALS_ASSETS
    .map(asset => asset.id)
    .filter(assetId => selected.has(assetId));

  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  return true;
}

function atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsPeriod(period) {
  const value = Number(period);
  if (![1, 7, 30, 90, 365].includes(value)) return false;
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().period = value;
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceRenderStrip?.();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  void atlasMetalsQuoteFoundationReloadHistory();
  return true;
}

function atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsView(view) {
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().view =
    view === "base100" ? "base100" : "price";
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceRenderStrip?.();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  return true;
}

function atlasParallelMarketSetMetalsSection(section) {
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsState().section =
    section === "critical" ? "critical" : "prices";
  atlasParallelMarketMetalsWrite();
  atlasParallelMarketRenderMetals();
  atlasWorkspaceRenderStrip?.();
  atlasWorkspaceScheduleSave?.(120);
  return true;
}

const ATLAS_WORKSPACE_SLOT_IDS = Object.freeze(["A", "B", "C"]);

const ATLAS_WORKSPACE_SLOT_PREFIX =
  "agent_crypto_erith_ia_comparison_memory_slot_v1_";

const ATLAS_WORKSPACE_SLOT_HOLD_MS = 720;

let atlasWorkspaceSlotHoldTimer = 0;

let atlasWorkspaceSlotHoldConsumed = false;

function atlasWorkspaceSlotNormalizeId(value) {
  const slot = String(value || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  return ATLAS_WORKSPACE_SLOT_IDS.includes(slot) ? slot : "";
}

function atlasWorkspaceSlotStorageKey(slotId) {
  const slot = atlasWorkspaceSlotNormalizeId(slotId);
  return slot ? `${ATLAS_WORKSPACE_SLOT_PREFIX}${slot}` : "";
}

function atlasWorkspaceSlotRead(slotId) {
  const slot = atlasWorkspaceSlotNormalizeId(slotId);
  if (!slot) return null;

  const stored = atlasWorkspaceReadJson(
    atlasWorkspaceSlotStorageKey(slot)
  );

  if (
    !stored
    || stored.schema !== "agent_crypto_compari
--- END ---
